# 2019-2020 Data Extraction

```{r}
#| label: 2019-2020-ingestion
#| cache: true
# path to unzipped .accdb file
# using normalize path  bc Windows ODBC driver was being weird
db_path <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS201920.accdb")
# establishing connection to db
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path)

# Retrieving 2019-20 Tables
institutional_chars <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2019")
student_financial_aid <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P1") # for pell percentage
student_financial_aid_2 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P2") # for net price
fall_enrollment_cip <- sqlFetch(con, "C2019_A") # for cip 
retention <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2019D")
# cleaning institutional characteristics
inst_clean_2019 <- institutional_chars |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr) # instnm is name, 
                                       # stabbr is state abbreviation

# cleaning retention
ret_clean_2019 <- retention |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf) # ret pres measures % of first-time, full-time undegraduates who return to same institution following fall

# cleaning financial aid data
aid_p1_clean <- student_financial_aid |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, pell_pct = pgrnt_p) 
aid_p2_clean <- student_financial_aid_2 |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, avg_net_public = npist2, avg_net_private = npgrn2, net_price_pell_proxy = npis412)
# note npist2 is used (average net price of students awarded grant or scholarship aid) bc npisur8 was not yet introduced
# npis412 is a proxy, it's 0-30k income net price

# joining the 2 aid tables
aid_final_2019 <- aid_p1_clean |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_clean, by = "unitid")
# calculating herfindahl-hirschman index using c2019_a
hhi_2019 <- fall_enrollment_cip |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  # filtering for just bachelor's degrees
  filter(awlevel == 5) |> 
  # extrating 2 digit cip code from 6-digit code
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  # grouping by school and department
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarize(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  # calculating share of total degrees for each dept
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  # squaring shares and summing for hhi score
  summarize(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> 
  ungroup()
# merging all 2019 tables
master_2019 <- inst_clean_2019 |> 
  left_join(ret_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_final_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2019-20")
print(master_2019)
odbcClose(con)
save(master_2019, file = "../master_2019.RData")
```

# 2020-2021 Data Extraction
```{r}
#| label: 2020-2021-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path_2020 <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS202021.accdb")
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path_2020)

# extracting and cleaning tables
# institutional characteristics
inst_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2020") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr)

# retention
ret_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2020D") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf)

# financial aid part 1 (pell %)
aid_p1_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1920_P1") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, pell_pct = upgrntp)
# financial aid pt 2 (net price)
aid_p2_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1920_P2") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, net_price_avg = npist2, net_price_pell_proxy = npis412)

# calculate hhi
hhi_2020 <- sqlFetch(con, "C2020_A") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids, awlevel == 5) |> 
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> 
  ungroup()

# merging all 2020 data
master_2020 <- inst_2020 |> 
  left_join(ret_2020, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p1_2020, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_2020, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2020, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2020-21")

# closing connection and saving
odbcClose(con)
save(master_2020, file = "../data/master_2020.RData")

```

# 2021-2022 Data Extraction
```{r}
#| label: 2021-2022-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path_2021 <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS202122.accdb")
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path_2021)
# institutional
inst_2021 <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2021") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr)

# retention rates
ret_2021 <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2021D") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf) # ret_pcf is full-time retention rate

# Financial Aid Part 1 (Pell %)
aid_p1_2021 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2021_P1") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, pell_pct = upgrntp)

# Financial Aid Part 2 (Net Price)
aid_p2_2021 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2021_P2") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, net_price_avg = npist2, net_price_pell_proxy = npis412)

# calculating hhi
hhi_2021 <- sqlFetch(con, "C2021_A") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids, awlevel == 5) |> 
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> 
  ungroup()

# merging all 2021-2022 tables
master_2021 <- inst_2021 |> 
  left_join(ret_2021, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p1_2021, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_2021, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2021, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2021-22")

# closing connection and saving
odbcClose(con)
save(master_2021, file = "../data/master_2021.RData")
```

```{r}
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids, awlevel == 5) |> 
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> 
  ungroup()

# merging all 2022-2023 data
master_2022 <- inst_2022 |> 
  left_join(ret_2022, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p1_2022, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_2022, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2022, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2022-23")

# closing connection and saving
odbcClose(con)
save(master_2022, file = "../data/master_2022.RData")

```

# 2023-2024 Data Extraction

```{r} 
#| label: 2023-2024-ingestion
#| cache: true
db_path_2023 <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS202324.accdb")
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path_2023)

# institutional data
inst_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2023") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr)
# retention data
ret_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2023D") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf)

# financial aid

# Net Price Data. For some reason this info swapped tables and is located in P2
# I'm still calling it p1 for consistency
aid_p1_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2223_P2") |> 
  clean_names(numerals = "asis") |> 
  # Using rename with 'any_of' to handle potential underscores in this years data
  rename(unitid = any_of(c("unit_id", "cgunitid")),
         net_price_avg = any_of(c("npist2", "npist_2")),
         net_price_pell_proxy = any_of(c("npis412", "npis_412"))) |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, net_price_avg, net_price_pell_proxy)

# Pell Percentage Data. 
# For some reason this info swapped tables and is located in P1.
# I'm still calling it p2 for consistency.
aid_p2_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA2223_P1") |> 
  clean_names(numerals = "asis") |> 
  rename(unitid = any_of(c("unit_id", "cgunitid")),
         pell_pct = any_of(c("upgrntp", "upgrnt_p"))) |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, pell_pct)

# calculating hhi
hhi_2023 <- sqlFetch(con, "C2023_A") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids, awlevel == 5) |> 
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarise(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  summarise(hhi_score = sum(share^2), .groups = "drop")

# master merge
master_2023 <- inst_2023 |> 
  left_join(ret_2023, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p1_2023, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_2023, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2023, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2023-24")

odbcClose(con)
save(master_2023, file = "../data/master_2023.RData")
```

```{r}
#| label: master-dataset
master_data <- bind_rows(
  master_2019,
  master_2020,
  master_2021,
  master_2022,
  master_2023
) |> 
  # making sure academic years are ordered
  mutate(academic_year = factor(academic_year, 
                               levels = c("2019-20", "2020-21", "2021-22", "2022-23", "2023-24")))


save(master_data, file = "../data/clean/master_longitudinal.RData")
write_csv(master_data, "../data/clean/master_longitudinal.csv")

```
